latin: Diffinitio generis quam dedit Porphyrius mala est, sed sic debet diffiniri: Genus est quod duorum uniuersalium est uniuersalius.
latin_note: 1486 read 'dabit Porphyrius', emended in the Emendationes errorum to 'dedit', a reading adopted by 1487 (farmer1998:13798); the sheet gives the emended reading.
translation: Porphyry's definition of genus is a poor one; genus should instead be defined as that which, between two universals, is the more universal.
translator: machine-drafted 2026-09-26 by TRANSLATOR-T02b; sense checked against farmer1998:13835; awaiting human check
